name: Trace MajorMUD callback registration
objective: Determine which host callbacks MajorMUD registers at startup and per session.
method: Instrument MBBSEmu exports REGISTER_MODULE, BEGIN_POLLING, RTKICK, RTIHDLR, SYSCYC assignment, INITASK and record module/routine/channel/timestamp.

name: Measure idle vs busy loop cadence
objective: Determine effective host processing cadence under no-input and active-output conditions.
method: Run instrumented MBBSEmu with Timer.Hertz values 0, 18, 36, 100 and record WorkerThread phase timestamps.

name: Output drain ordering
objective: Determine whether gameplay state updates are observed before/after OUTPUT_BUFFER_EMPTY status processing.
method: Log SendToClient enqueue time, DataToClient drain time, OUTPUT_BUFFER_EMPTY enqueue/process time, STSROU calls.

name: RTKICK/RTIHDLR/SYSCYC ordering
objective: Confirm timed routine order and delay behavior under active channel load.
method: Register mock module routines for each timed callback and compare execution order/timestamp across repeated runs.
